Class CraftTweakerText.Layout

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerText.Layout
Enclosing class:
CraftTweakerText
public static final class CraftTweakerText.Layout extends Object
Immutable shared-parser layout with ZenScript-friendly access to the original glyph/style data.
